Passages:

[support] Community support (Starter) is best-effort via the forum. Email support (Pro) is staffed Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 18:00 UTC, with a one-business-day first-response target. Enterprise support is 24/7 for severity-1 incidents with a four-hour response target, and business hours for everything else. Severity-1 means the product is unavailable or data is at risk for all users of a workspace. Status and incident history are published on the status page.

[plans] Starter includes up to 5 seats, 10,000 API calls per month and community support. Pro includes unlimited seats at a per-seat price, 250,000 API calls per month, SSO, audit logs and email support with a one-business-day response target. Enterprise adds a custom API quota, dedicated support with a four-hour response target, data residency options and a signed DPA. Upgrades apply immediately and are prorated; downgrades apply at the next renewal.

[refunds] Annual plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. After 14 days, annual plans are not refundable, but you can cancel auto-renewal at any time and keep access until the end of the term. Monthly plans are not refundable; cancelling stops the next charge. Refunds are issued to the original payment method and typically arrive within 5 business days, though some banks take up to 10. To request a refund, open a ticket from the billing page with the invoice number; a billing specialist replies within one business day.

Answer:
The Pro plan offers email support with a one-business-day first-response target [support].
